title: Quarantine ipv6-addresses.json native-profile fields; reconcile cross-impl test
description: Slice of q6ko discovered during recon: test/vectors/ipv6-addresses.json key_derived_identity vectors carry native_packed/native/iid fields from the same rejected SHA-512 native profile, and python/tests/ipv6/test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py::test_native_corpora_agree_without_byte_reversal cross-asserts them against the yggdrasil_address.json native vectors (shared_keys >= 4). Survey ALL consumers of ipv6-addresses.json first (rust/python/C), then apply the q6ko quarantine decision consistently (label or move the native-profile fields) and reconcile/retire the cross-impl test so nothing presents the rejected profile as a live conformance oracle. Do not weaken pinned upstream byte-equality vectors.
close_reason: Quarantined ipv6-addresses.json native-profile fields: native/native_packed/iid_in_native moved from the 5 key_derived_identity vectors into test/vectors/legacy/ipv6_addresses_native_sha512.json (verbatim values verified against removed diff lines). Live corpus carries only live IID + link-local derivations; description/oracle metadata updated; generator (generate_ipv6_addresses.py) no longer emits the fields and the rewritten corpus is byte-identical to json_bytes(document()) so --check stays byte-exact (host --check exits 2 on this group-writable checkout — the pre-existing umask/atomic_json P3 filed last round, content-independent). Consumers updated with quarantine-integrity framing: rust ipv6_address_vectors.rs (legacy twin load + leak tripwire asserting none of the 3 quarantined fields in the live corpus), python test_addr.py and test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py (both byte-exact and corpora-agree tests read native expectations from legacy). spec/04-network.md §12.2 repointed to the legacy corpus for the native fields (review finding). READMEs updated incl. index row. Verified: cargo test -p lichen-core green; pytest tests/ipv6 + test_vectors.py 959 passed, sole failure = pre-existing umask/atomic_json generator check. Codereview 3x all delegated to reviewer model: correctness found leak-tripwire omission (iid_in_native) — fixed; security found §12.2 stale pointer + README index omission + generator docstring staleness — all fixed; edge-cases found §12.2 (same) + verified schema-policy drift consistency, byte-exact generator equality, include_str! path, corpus-shape assertions — all clean. Commit 457a8bf68c.
